Therefore, it was concluded that the optimal HRT for HPR in this study was 6 h with the highest HPR of 8.02 mmol/(h·L). The generated biogas was composed of hydrogen and carbon dioxide. Methane was not detected throughout the whole study which sup- ported the effectiveness of heat pretreatment on seed sludge.
